it.txt: Era vice-governador e assumiu em 31/03/2026 depois que Mauro Mendes renunciou para disputar o Senado
it.txt_en: He was vice governor. He became governor on March 31, 2026, after Mauro Mendes resigned to run for the Senate.

it.txt: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, tomou posse como prefeito interino em 21/07/2026, em sessão solene da Câmara, depois da cassação dos mandatos do prefeito Léo de Doquinha e do vice João Eudes, eleitos em 2024. A eleição suplementar para prefeito e vice está marcada para 06/12/2026.
it.txt_en: As president of the City Council, he was sworn in as acting mayor on July 21, 2026, in a formal session of the City Council, after the terms of Mayor Léo de Doquinha and Vice Mayor João Eudes, elected in 2024, were revoked. The special election for mayor and vice mayor is scheduled for December 6, 2026.
